description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of two models, LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B, on the CoLeG-E benchmark, measured as a percentage, under four different conditions: no SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning), SFT on $D_0$, SFT on $D_0, D_1$, and SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. The x-axis displays the model names, while the y-axis represents the CoLeG-E score in percentage. For LLaMA-2-13B, the performance increases from approximately 5% with no SFT to about 30% with SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. For LLaMA-2-70B, the performance is significantly higher, starting at around 27% with no SFT and reaching nearly 50% with SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$. The chart shows that both models benefit from SFT, with the performance improving as more data domains are included. The model LLaMA-2-70B consistently outperforms LLaMA-2-13B across all conditions.
